rationale: A prior load test (recorded as an explicit rejection, id 05be09c6) showed that 4 or 8 workers caused retries and reduced throughput because all workers share one upstream account with a concurrency ceiling of 2. No new load test or account-limit change has since been recorded, so that constraint still holds. Raising from 1 → 2 doubles throughput and directly reduces the 8-feed backlog without breaching the account limit.
